description: Expected results for the SHAW 3.0.3 official 'Trial' demo. Values were recorded from a clean-directory run of the shipped shaw303 binary on the authentic inputs in inputs/ (not hand-written). Checks use tolerances so a correct build on another machine still passes; output-file sha256 are informational only (floating-point output varies by platform).

numeric_checks.name: final_cumulative_ET_mm
numeric_checks.why: cumulative evapotranspiration over the 13-day run, last water-balance row

numeric_checks.name: water_balance_error_mm
numeric_checks.why: mass-balance closure error must stay near zero

numeric_checks.name: final_snow_depth_cm
numeric_checks.why: simulated snow depth on the final day

numeric_checks.name: final_SWE_mm
numeric_checks.why: snow water equivalent on the final day
